mapper.sql: t.id, t.instance_id, t.node_name, t.node_id, t.node_type, t.assignee_id, t.status, t.comment, t.handle_time, t.create_time, t.deadline, t.read_flag, pd.name AS process_name, wi.title AS instance_title, wi.initiator_id, COALESCE((SELECT e.name FROM org_employee e WHERE e.user_id = wi.initiator_id AND e.deleted = 0 ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1), su.nickname, su.username) AS initiator_name, wi.start_time, CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(wi.form_data) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wi.form_data, '$.amount')) END AS amount, CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(wi.form_data) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wi.form_data, '$.days')) END AS days

if.test: q != null and q.keyword != null and q.keyword != ''

sql.if: AND ( wi.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR pd.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR su.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR su.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_employee ek WHERE ek.user_id = wi.initiator_id AND ek.deleted = 0 AND ek.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')) )

if.test: q != null and q.processKey != null and q.processKey != ''

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM wf_task t LEFT JOIN wf_instance wi ON t.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN wf_process_def pd ON wi.process_def_id = pd.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = wi.initiator_id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 AND wi.deleted = 0
AND t.create_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND t.create_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM wf_task t LEFT JOIN wf_instance wi ON t.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN wf_process_def pd ON wi.process_def_id = pd.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = wi.initiator_id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status IN (1, 2, 3, 6) AND t.node_type != 'cc' AND t.deleted = 0 AND wi.deleted = 0
AND t.handle_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND t.handle_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY t.handle_time DESC

SELECT
FROM wf_task t LEFT JOIN wf_instance wi ON t.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN wf_process_def pd ON wi.process_def_id = pd.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = wi.initiator_id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.node_type = 'cc' AND t.deleted = 0 AND wi.deleted = 0
AND t.create_time >= CONCAT(#{q.startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND t.create_time <= CONCAT(#{q.endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
